zh-CN.showTooltip: 显示并还原 Jeemi 主界面
zh-CN.reloadTooltip: 界面白屏或显示异常时重新加载 Jeemi 界面
zh-CN.reloadMessage: 重新加载界面会丢弃未保存的编辑，并返回主页。mihomo 会保持运行，已保存的配置不受影响。是否继续？
zh-CN.startProxyTooltip: 使用当前订阅和运行配置启动代理
zh-CN.stopProxyTooltip: 恢复网络设置并停止代理
zh-CN.restartProxyTooltip: 按当前配置完整重启代理
zh-CN.proxyFailure: 代理操作未完成，请在主页查看运行状态。若授权助手尚未安装、需要更新或修复，请在主页点击启动代理进行处理。

en-US.showTooltip: Show and restore the Jeemi window
en-US.reloadTooltip: Reload the Jeemi interface if it is blank or displays incorrectly
en-US.reloadMessage: Reloading discards unsaved edits and returns to home. mihomo will keep running and saved configuration is unchanged. Continue?
en-US.startProxyTooltip: Start the proxy with the current subscription and runtime configuration
en-US.stopProxyTooltip: Restore network settings and stop the proxy
en-US.restartProxyTooltip: Fully restart the proxy with the current configuration
en-US.proxyFailure: The proxy action could not be completed. Check the runtime status on Home. If the authorization helper needs installation, an update or repair, click Start proxy on Home to continue.
